blueprint.summary: Dallas Cowboys hold $16.70M in 2026 OverTheCap space ($16.70M effective) and +$0.30M projected for 2027.
blueprint.executiveSummary: Jerry Jones and the Cowboys front office hold $16.70M in gross 2026 cap space ($16.70M effective), while 2027 currently projects at +$0.30M under an estimated $327M cap ceiling. Rolling unused 2026 cap space 1-for-1 under CBA Article 13 ($10M–$14M target) helps manage scheduled cap escalations for Dak Prescott, George Pickens, CeeDee Lamb, Tyler Smith.

strategicPillars.title: 1. CBA Article 13 Rollover Bridge ($10M–$14M Target vs. +$0.30M 2027 Projection)
strategicPillars.detail: Unused 2026 cap space carries over dollar-for-dollar into 2027, buffering Dallas's projected 2027 ledger without forcing premature void-year restructures.

strategicPillars.title: 2. Prorated Base Salary & Option-Bonus Architecture
strategicPillars.detail: Converting base salary or option bonuses spreads cap charges across up to 5 years (including void years) while preserving weekly in-season flexibility.
